finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann hormonelle und neuronale Steuerkreise gemeinsam erläutern.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can explain hormonal and neuronal control circuits together.

synthesis.synthesizedBy: Codex technical integrator under Root delegated factual paired KEEP decisions; no new scientific reviewer
synthesis.rationaleDe: Vom Root delegierte faktische KEEP-Zusammenführung zweier versiegelter unabhängiger nativer Erstpass-Nachweise; keine neue Autor-Fachbewertung. A: Nervensignal, hormonelle Freisetzung, Blutweg und passender/nicht passender Zielrezeptor sind klar. Es wird das gekoppelte Grundmodell, kein vollständiger messbarer Regelkreis dargestellt. Eigenständig tatsächlich gesichtete neue PDF-Zielseite und vollständiges DE/EN-Ziel; aktuelle Quellen-/Kontext-/Bildbindung geprüft, unveränderte fachliche D/P-Körper aus gültigen Reviews weiterverwendet. Keine menschliche Freigabe, kein Bild als Leistungsnachweis und keine Whole-Source-Abnahme. B: The actual joint hormonal/neural page retains the forward neural-to-gland-to-blood-to-receptor chain. It is orientation to a component, while the retained P cases still carry explanation of control circuits; the picture is not complete feedback evidence. The actual complete native page shows the full goal ID, complete title/description, image, prerequisite/reverse links and footer without clipping or overlap. Image text remains legible at its actual printed page placement. Targeted final binding review reuses unchanged bounded DE/EN science and exact valid P profile; actual physical PDF page 7 was viewed. Whole-source HOLDs remain; the drawing supplies orientation and does not replace either complete performance case. Native subset navigation and external relation routing are scoped to this exact input. Independent first pass was sealed before any new Root D-A judgment access.
synthesis.rationaleEn: Root-delegated factual KEEP synthesis of two sealed independent native first-pass records over the exact final bilingual goal, PDF page, original raster and bounded source/context input. A evidence: Neural and hormonal information pathways can jointly control a bodily response. Neural signals follow directed cell connections; hormones reach suitable receptor-bearing target cells through their transport pathway. Time courses alone do not replace a mechanism explanation. B evidence: Neural and hormonal information pathways can jointly control a bodily response. Neural signals follow directed cell connections; hormones reach suitable receptor-bearing target cells through their transport pathway. Time courses alone do not replace a mechanism explanation. Existing current scientific material bodies remain bound, with the actual current080v4 replacement. This synthesis grants no human approval, whole-source approval or central strict gain.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Neuronale und hormonelle Informationswege können gemeinsam eine Körperreaktion steuern. Neuronale Signale laufen über gerichtete Zellverbindungen; Hormone erreichen über den Transportweg geeignete Zielzellen mit passenden Rezeptoren. Zeitverläufe allein ersetzen keine Mechanismuserklärung.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Neural and hormonal information pathways can jointly control a bodily response. Neural signals follow directed cell connections; hormones reach suitable receptor-bearing target cells through their transport pathway. Time courses alone do not replace a mechanism explanation.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die lernende Person verbindet in einem gegebenen Regelkreisschema neuronale und hormonelle Teilwege und begründet ihre unterschiedlichen Beiträge.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: The learner connects neural and hormonal branches in a supplied control diagram and explains their different contributions.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Die Zielantwort des betroffenen Organs kann fehlen, obwohl die vorgelagerten neuronalen und hormonellen Signale weiter bestehen. Das erlaubt keine Behauptung, dass die ganze Stressreaktion oder alle anderen Zielorgane blockiert sind.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: The affected organ's response may be absent although upstream neural and hormonal signals persist. This does not establish blockade of the entire stress response or every other target organ.

dissent.textEn: The two current keep reviews differ in understandingEvidence, rationale, evidenceProfileRecommendation; the manifest explicitly selects the evidence formulation from the first round.
